title: About this site
text:
This site is the public-facing home for QMCPy. It is intended to make project news, community information, and learning pathways easier to find.
The detailed package documentation is maintained separately in the QMCSoftware repository and published with MkDocs at the QMCPy documentation site. This website links to that documentation rather than duplicating it.

title: Blog
text:
The QMCPy blog archive will be added in a later migration phase. Existing posts have not been copied or converted for this prototype.
In the meantime, visit the technical documentation for guides and examples.
